en: Black‑and‑white interior view of an exhibition room with framed photo collages of many people on the walls and a glass‑topped display table and single wooden chair in the center. Two large signs at the top of the walls read "VÄRLDPOST-FÖRENINGEN". The overall look is of an early‑to‑mid 20th‑century museum or exhibition dedicated to the World Postal Union or a similar postal association.
